csv_project_name: General Engineering Services Modal Development - Dist 6
csv_scope_of_work: The Florida Department of Transportation (Department) requires professional services of a General Engineering Consultant (Consultant) for a wide range of engineering, premium transit, modal (Aviation, Seaport, Rail, Freight), survey, architectural, landscaping, technical, management and administrative services as needed to assist in executing projects in the District Six Work Program. The Consultant will primarily support the District Six Modal Development Office (MDO).

short_description: Framework-style general engineering services for multimodal development projects in FDOT District 6.

services: General engineering consulting; architecture; landscape architecture; civil engineering; geotechnical engineering; surveying/GIS/mapping; construction/project management; technical, management, and administrative support.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad general engineering services contract without a defined bridge, building, roof, or special structure.
- Includes many disciplines, but no clear structural engineering focus aligned with sbp core strengths.

- Contains substantial management, administrative, surveying, traffic, and geotechnical components, which are not primary sbp targets.
- No specific innovative, long-span, lightweight, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
